response.sql: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), overall AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled FROM orderexecutions), above_overall AS (SELECT o.avg_unfilled, v.avg_unfilled AS overall_avg FROM order_averages AS o CROSS JOIN overall AS v WHERE o.avg_unfilled > v.avg_unfilled), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS avg_unfilled FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.avg_unfilled) AS average_unfilled, AVG(a.avg_unfilled - a.overall_avg) AS average_excess_over_overall, AVG(a.avg_unfilled - s.avg_unfilled) AS average_excess_over_second FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN second_average AS s WHERE a.avg_unfilled > s.avg_unfilled;
